q: Is the ChatGPT business listing free?
a: Yes. Claiming your business in ChatGPT's Business Hub is free, and you don't need a paid ChatGPT plan, an ads account or a Shopify store to do it.

q: Will claiming my business make ChatGPT recommend me more?
a: Not on its own, and OpenAI says so plainly: claiming lets you manage the information about your business, but it doesn't guarantee more visibility or control what ChatGPT recommends. What it does give you is the facts in your own words, what you sell in a form ChatGPT can read, and numbers on how often ChatGPT mentions you. The website work is what earns the mentions.

q: I'm in Australia. Can I claim my business?
a: If you sell online, yes: online stores and online service businesses can claim today. If you are a local business with a shopfront, such as a cafe, clinic or trade business, ChatGPT only lets you claim an existing US listing for now. Everyone can still do the website work, and ChatGPT Ads are available in Australia.

q: What do I need to do myself?
a: Two things only you can do. Prove the business is yours, with a code to your business phone or email, or a record on your website's domain, which we can add for you. Then a quick identity check with your ID and business registration details. We walk you through both and do the rest.

q: I sell a service, not products. Is it still worth it?
a: Yes. Your profile, your description and your website are what ChatGPT reads when someone asks for a business like yours, whatever you sell. Services can also be added the same way as products, with a name, a description and a price.

q: Can you manage it for me?
a: Yes. You stay the owner of the listing. ChatGPT lets the owner give an agency access, so we keep it up to date without needing your login.

People using ChatGPT's free plan. Ads aren't shown on the paid plans or to anyone under 18. Your ad sits below ChatGPT's answer, with your business name, logo, a headline, a short message, an image and a link to your site.

You set the budget. The minimum is 25 dollars a day, and you choose to pay for views, clicks or results. There are no keywords: we describe the conversations your business fits, and ChatGPT uses that to decide where your ad shows. We start small and tell you plainly what it bought.

q: Why are some of my numbers blank?
a: A blank number in ChatGPT's insights isn't zero. It can mean the count is still under the level ChatGPT reports. A mention is counted when ChatGPT points to your website, not when it just says your name.
